browser.meaning: Application for HTTP and HTTPS. Non-objects are stringified; xdg-settings must accept both handlers before mimeapps.list is edited.

mail.meaning: Application for mailto, stringified before writing.

calendar.meaning: Application for text/calendar, stringified before writing.

music.meaning: Application for audio/mpeg, audio/ogg and audio/*, stringified before writing.

video.meaning: Application for video/mp4 and video/*, stringified before writing.

photos.meaning: Application for image/jpeg, image/png and image/*, stringified before writing.

text_editor.meaning: Application for text/plain, stringified before writing.

terminal.meaning: Application for application/x-terminal, stringified before writing.

file_manager.meaning: Application for inode/directory, stringified before writing.

changed.meaning: Reported on success; whether the file replacement recorded a change.

receiptPath.meaning: Path of the successful run.json written by the settings receipt writer.

receipt.meaning: Settings metadata with ok, changed, kind, requested fields, backups and commands; present once the settings receipt is finished.

mutationPerformed.meaning: Explicitly false on early intake or field refusal; not emitted by the finished settings receipt.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Present on refusal. A request needs at least one of the listed categories, but no individual category is required. Unknown keys yield unknown-field:<key>. Validation can also return missing envelope kernel keys: <comma-separated keys> or raw OS or decoding diagnostics.
